title: EPSRC CDT MRes + PhD in Sensor Technologies and Applications
about: The University of Cambridge EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Sensor Technologies and Applications offers a combined MRes and PhD starting October 2027. The funding deadline for all applicants, including international, is 6 January 2027; first-round interviews run late January to February 2027.
requirements: Single application for the combined MRes and PhD
Eligible applicants are considered automatically for funded places
Final course deadline for externally or self-funded applicants in May 2027

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems I
why: Field "Sensor technologies and applications" → objective "Robot perception: sensor fusion, SLAM (simultaneous localisation and mapping)"
